extension.summary: Πρόσθετο ANT1 Player για το Kodi
extension.description: ANT1 live and on-demand broadcasts, Greece and Cyprus
Ζωντανές και on demand υπηρεσίες του ANT1, Ελλάδα και Κύπρος
extension.disclaimer: This addon offers content available in Greece and Cyprus and is not published nor endorsed by antenna.gr or ant1live.com
Το πρόσθετο αυτό προσφέρει περιεχόμενο διαθέσιμο στην Ελλάδα και την Κύπρο και δεν έχει δημοσιευθεί ούτε εγκριθεί από το antenna.gr ή το ant1live.com
extension.news:
[B]4.0.0[/B] - Complete rework for the current antenna.gr: four live channels with program titles, full shows index with categories, per-show video archives, news and lifestyle sections with server-side paging, sports highlights, Web TV latest and the soundis radio stations - Added the Cyprus region (ant1live.com) with its own live channel, news, entertainment, podcast, series and movie sections, mirroring the Alpha Player GR/CY split; region switching via a dedicated selector line or the context menu - Stream resolution delegated to ResolveURL / the PluginsGR Ant1GR and Ant1CY resolvers - Gated ANT1+ items surface an info dialog instead of a failed playback - Full detail metadata for Cyprus movies and episodes: cover fanart, posters, plot, director, cast, year and genre - Per-section artwork in the addon style (white on black) plus the original icon set - Fixed empty show categories with a fallback to the filtered full index - Dropped the plugin.video.youtube dependency, its embedded API key and the YouTube context menu - Removed the games section (browser games, unplayable in Kodi) - Modernized stack: tulip 4.x, urldispatcher, netclient, unicache
[B]3.0.1[/B] - Fix tubed_API key
[B]3.0.0[/B] - Rework on the libraries
